YEAR 4 • ENGLISH READING

Durian: The King of Fruits

Read, think, drag and drop! Can you complete all six sentences?

📖 Reading Time

Durian is a famous fruit in Malaysia. Many people call it the King of Fruits. It has a big, green shell with sharp thorns. Inside the fruit, there is soft, yellow flesh. Durian has a strong smell. Some people love the smell, but others do not. The fruit tastes sweet and creamy. People can eat durian fresh or use it to make cakes and ice cream. Durian is a special fruit enjoyed by many Malaysians.
